# Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration

# Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-31 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Set enabled=true explicitly: the API and Pulumi documentation both say an omitted enabled setting defaults to false. A successfully created configuration can therefore remain disabled. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] OneUptime publishes a billing-alert example at /api/atlas/v2/orgs/${ORG_ID}/alerts/settings using CREDIT_CARD_CURRENT_MONTH_USAGE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED and threshold.unitName=DOLLARS. These differ from the inspected project API route, five-event billing schema, and threshold.units=RAW. The snippet is not a verified Admin API recipe. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-03-31) — https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-atlas-flex-cluster-storage-limits/view · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The documented creation route is POST /api/atlas/v2/groups/{groupId}/alertConfigs. The groupId identifies a project; Pulumi AlertConfiguration exposes projectId and describes a project-scoped resource. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/
- [statement] The project billing-threshold schema accepts PENDING_INVOICE_OVER_THRESHOLD, DAILY_BILL_OVER_THRESHOLD, DAILY_BILLING_CHANGE_OVER_THRESHOLD, WEEKLY_BILLING_CHANGE_OVER_THRESHOLD, and MONTHLY_BILLING_CHANGE_OVER_THRESHOLD. The event catalog marks these events alertable. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/atlas-alert-event-types/
- [statement] The API billing-threshold object uses threshold.operator = GREATER_THAN, an integer threshold.threshold, and threshold.units = RAW, whose default is RAW. This schema does not specify DOLLARS or unitName. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig
- [statement] Organization Billing Admin (ORG_BILLING_ADMIN) can create, edit, delete, acknowledge, and unacknowledge billing alerts. Organization Owner manages all organization alerts; project alert management requires Project Owner or Project Alerts Manager access. These scope-specific privileges should not be treated as interchangeable. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/user-roles.md · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts/
- [statement] The yesterday-amount billing alert uses USD and excludes credits applied for the previous day. It applies to organizations and projects. It should therefore not be interpreted as a real-time measurement of net spend after credits. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions/
- [statement] Organization UI alerts include organization current-invoice and any-single-project monthly-cost thresholds. The event catalog identifies these as ORG_INVOICE_OVER_THRESHOLD and ORG_GROUP_CHARGES_OVER_THRESHOLD. Their presence does not establish that the project creation route accepts them. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions/ · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/atlas-alert-event-types/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig
- [statement] The inspected Admin API alert-configuration operation list and Pulumi resource are project-scoped. Neither source corroborates the organization-scoped URL examples published by OneUptime; use the documented project route for project automation and verify organization automation separately. This is a documentation finding, not a live endpoint test. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/, https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-atlas-flex-cluster-storage-limits/view, https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-monitor-and-forecast-infrastructure-costs/view
- [statement] Atlas documentation says the UI send-if-condition-lasts and resend-after controls are available only for host alerts, not event-based billing alerts. Do not assume host-alert persistence and resend controls apply to billing conditions. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts/ · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts.md
- [statement] For the raw v2 billing payload, use threshold with operator GREATER_THAN, an integer threshold, and units RAW. Pulumi names its corresponding wrapper input thresholdConfig; its metricThresholdConfig input addresses metric-based events. Do not copy wrapper property names directly into the REST JSON. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/
- [statement] EMAIL notification targets require emailAddress. delayMin controls the first notification delay and intervalMin controls repeats; the API specifies a minimum interval of five minutes. Pulumi exposes these notification settings. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.pulumi.com/registry/packages/mongodbatlas/api-docs/alertconfiguration/
- [statement] Billing alert scope matters: the conditions guide assigns current organization bill and current bill for any single project to organization-level alerts, while project daily/weekly/monthly billing-change alerts belong to projects. The event catalog separately identifies ORG-prefixed daily and change events. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions/ · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/atlas-alert-event-types/
- [statement] The v2 create-project-alert operation lists Project Alerts Manager as its role requirement. The alert configuration guide permits Project Owner or Project Alerts Manager for project alerts, and limits organization-wide alert management to Organization Owner, with limited billing-alert authorization for Organization Billing Admin. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-alerts/
- [statement] OneUptime’s March 31, 2026 tutorial demonstrates an enabled PENDING_INVOICE_OVER_THRESHOLD configuration with a GREATER_THAN threshold and an email recipient. Its example targets /api/atlas/v1.0/orgs/{orgId}/alertConfigs; this is a different version and scope from the verified v2 project endpoint, so the example does not validate a current organization-level API creation route. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-monitor-and-forecast-infrastructure-costs/view · keywords: Atlas Admin API billing alert configuration · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-creategroupalertconfig
